card.what: The jib lead: a 22 mm small-boat pinstop track with an end stop at each end, and a slider car carrying the lead sheave, a pinstop and an eye strap
card.boats: J/22 (600 mm, a side deck each side beside the cockpit's forward end; the hero places it); fleet builds use 450 and 900 mm
card.distance: arm's reach from the helm and the trimmer's seat; the sheet runs through it on every tack
card.before: October kit JibTrack: a 25 mm T-track with raised round screw heads, a tapered block for a car, a sheave between flat stainless cheeks, a plain black plunger post; no end stops or holes

references.use: what the J/22 carries: 22 mm small-boat track and a 22 mm car on each side deck
references.url: Harken J/22 one-design deck layout (harken.com, search-result text; the site is blocked from the cloud)

references.use: sizes: 22 mm low-beam pinstop track, 600 mm = 252 g, 5 mm flat-head fasteners every 100 mm, 6061-T6 hard-anodised
references.url: Harken 2751 retailer listings (sailingservices.com, fisheriessupply.com; numbers only)

references.use: sizes: 22 mm pinstop slider car with sheave, 95 mm long, 35 mm wide, 38 mm sheave, line to 12 mm (replaces the older 393 cars)
references.url: Harken G226S listings (sailingservices.com, velasailingsupply.com; numbers only)

references.use: the pinstop eye-strap car: 88 mm long, 33 mm wide (the eye the J/22's 2:1 sheet ties to)
how it is used: the sheet runs from the clew to the car's sheave; the J/22 2:1 sheet ties to the car's eye; standard lead in line with the mast and chainplates, aft a hole or two in a breeze
references.url: North Sails J/22 tuning guide; UCI J/22 sailing manual; West Coast Sailing J/22 2:1 jib sheet listing

features.text: A low 22 mm T-section track with a waist under its head (the car's lips run under it), not a flat bar
A row of pinstop holes along the track's top
Countersunk flat-head screws every 100 mm, flush with the top
An end stop at each end of the track
A slider car with rounded ends and black slide liners, wider than the track
A grooved sheave held high between two stainless cheeks, its rim showing above them, with room under it for the sheet
A spring pinstop with a pull knob at the car's aft end
An eye strap at the car's forward end (the 2:1 sheet's standing end)
Aluminium track and car, stainless cheeks and fasteners, black sheave, stops and knob

budget.note: two on the J/22; 900 mm fleet tracks have more holes
